variables: ordered mode IDs/names/parent IDs/raw values; aliases represented by target variable IDs
styles: properties including variable alias target IDs

fingerprint.numbers: Finite numbers use decimal form rounded to at most 12 fractional places with trailing zeroes removed; negative zero is 0.
fingerprint.identityAndSorting: Identity and primary sort use key, falling back to id only when key is absent; id and key remain fingerprint values.
fingerprint.arrays: Collection modes retain Figma order; scopes and top-level variable/style state records are sorted lexicographically; all other arrays retain semantic source order.

naming.input: Full slash-delimited variable name plus its collection family/name.
transformations: Drop one leading segment when its normalized value is core.
After normalization, drop a leading variable path segment when it equals the normalized collection family/name.
Collapse an immediately preceding normalized segment when the next segment is identical or begins with the preceding segment plus a hyphen.
naming.manualPrecedence: A non-empty variable.codeSyntax value is emitted unchanged with source manual; otherwise the derived value is emitted.

units.statement: Figma stores numeric values, not responsive CSS or platform units. storedUnit/sourceUnit describe the raw design value; buildUnit is a recommendation.
rules: Opacity and explicit percentage semantics infer one scale per collection/group cohort.
Classified FLOAT modes carry deterministic build cells.
Effect blur radii remain px and integral grid column counts remain unitless.
Aliases inherit terminal type, scope, name, collection, and cohort semantics.
Contextual pixel line height and letter spacing convert using the known font size.

typeRamp.statement: Typography preserves exact Figma values and binding provenance while exposing contextual developer-ready values.

responsive.statement: Figma mode values remain source samples; endpoint clamps are recommendations only when every sample fits.

contentHash.serialization: The same canonical serializer as fingerprint.policy.
contentHash.stablePayload: Schema/contract/lane, document and page identity, selected node IDs/names, options, current design-system state hash, policy metadata, companion identity excluding generation time, and Markdown body excluding generated metadata lines.
exclusions: Time-derived export filename and rendered generated metadata lines.

children.name: NavigationHeader
annotations:
The content of the HeaderNavigation is contextual, depending on the page, Title, Description and actions will change.


At sm+ (md) breakpoint NavigationSecondary is used for actions. Positioned at the bottom of the viewport

Scroll behaviour
md+:
Fades-out on scroll down
Fades-in on scroll up
Page end fades in
sm:
Fades out on scroll down
Title only fades-in on scroll up
Page end fades in

Motion
All breakpoints:
Full swipe/rise motion law  on page reload 
Between pages, Full swipe/rise motion law if different content, if no content change it stays persistent.

children.name: NavigationSecondary
annotations:
Scroll behaviour
md+: 
Stays fixed on page as you scroll


sm: 
Fades out on scroll down
Fades-in on scroll up

Motion
